Item-response probabilities of an LCA

itemprobs.Rd

Class-specific probabilities of every category of every indicator.

Usage

itemprobs(object, group = 1, wave = 1)

Arguments

object

A fitted LCA, multigroup LCA, LTA, or mixture() model with categorical indicators (latentmix; only those are returned).

group

Group of a multigroup model (in the order of object$group_levels).

wave

Wave of an LTA.

Value

A named list with one category-by-class matrix per indicator (rows: category labels or codes; columns class1, ..., classK; columns sum to 1).

See also

parameters(), lca(), lta()

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# item-response probabilities of the ACE classes
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4)     # 4 ACE classes, as generated
#> Starting Julia ...
ip <- itemprobs(m)
ip$ace_emo_abuse                      # P(emotional abuse = 0/1 | class)
#>       class1    class2    class3    class4
#> 0 0.93938127 0.2093157 0.8075377 0.1790758
#> 1 0.06061873 0.7906843 0.1924623 0.8209242
sapply(ip, function(p) p["1", ])      # P(item = 1) for every item and class
#>        ace_emo_abuse ace_phys_abuse ace_sex_abuse ace_emo_neglect
#> class1    0.06061873     0.03544369    0.04521587      0.04366351
#> class2    0.79068430     0.58760526    0.35015961      0.63242019
#> class3    0.19246226     0.16771307    0.07444641      0.17194025
#> class4    0.82092423     0.72415866    0.48841439      0.71835409
#>        ace_phys_neglect ace_violence ace_substance ace_mental
#> class1       0.01410293   0.04136535    0.05742902 0.08639991
#> class2       0.30872002   0.20072575    0.18636081 0.24702964
#> class3       0.10910618   0.54045624    0.82179402 0.55700248
#> class4       0.50272074   0.85656269    0.89906112 0.81024549
# }
